The correct option is **inspiratory component louder and longer with a gap between inspiration and expiration** — that describes normal (vesicular) breathing, so if "bronchial breathing" is the stem, the phrasing is odd. Classic bronchial breathing has an expiratory phase equal to or louder/longer than inspiration, with a gap between inspiration and expiration; the option closest to that is the first listed ("gap between inspiration and expiration").  
CONFIDENCE: 70
